reviews.title: Great app BUT
reviews.text: don’t matter the version/update this app takes 1-2 minutes to pull up your library. Every time, for YEARS now. Sometimes it takes longer than that and you basically gotta close out the app completely and reopen it maybe 2-3 times. But yeah great filters and adjustments but that loading time finna have you just opening up Lightroom instead.

reviews.title: Changed a lot
reviews.text: I used to love this app for my photos and videos. It’s changed so much. the ads are ridiculous. I have to click on the ad in order to get the close x tab in the corner.

reviews.title: Very very slow and keeps crashing
reviews.text:
I made a mistake and paid in full w/o a trial. 
I admit I have over 400k photos on my phone - maybe it’s a reason why the app is way too slow to open an image from my photo album “processing” icon goes for ever (!) 
In addition it quits/crashes in the middle every time I use it. 
I’d love to get a full refund (i have been using this app for no more than 5days now) and it’s painful to use it. 
Not cool to charge so much with so many bugs.
